notes: Mechanical split of the pre-Round-28 quests (legacy fields, line 'legacy'); the zone's design replaces this file.

quests.title: Tusks at the Timberline
quests.text: Boars are tearing through the timberline stores outside Hearthpine. Drive off three by day, and bring any ordinary meat you keep to Hilda Hearthspoon at the separate oven.

quests.title: Meat for the Smokehouse
quests.text: The shared oven feeds everyone returning from hearthpine's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Hilda Hearthspoon beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

quests.title: Boards for the Winter Stacks
quests.text: The woodpile pests exposed rotten braces beneath the winter stacks. Bring six pine planks for the store frames; ordinary boards from local pine trunks, carried or traded, are equally useful.

quests.title: Lanterns After Sundown
quests.text: After nightfall, zombies approach the lantern line outside Hearthpine. Defeat three on that night patrol. They begin in the level-3 country; do the daytime store work or optional tool lessons if the sun is still up.

quests.title: The High Path
quests.text: Ibex knock loose slate above Hearthpine's high path by day. Clear the animals on level-4-and-up ground along the ledges.

quests.title: The Road to Orrik Pineledger
quests.text: At level 10, take the road to Copperfell Village and speak with Orrik Pineledger. Copperfell Foothills is level 11–20 country: this is a conversation handoff, not a demand to clear the whole road. Complete it with Orrik at the village.

quests.title: An Axe Worth Carrying
quests.text:
Bring a wood axe so Brunna can show where its edge belongs and where it does not.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

quests.title: Stone Before Steel
quests.text:
Bring a stone pick. The lesson is optional, but the mountain is less forgiving than wood.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

quests.title: Warmth for the Timber Shift
quests.text: Hilda keeps the timber shift fed beside Hearthpine's oven. Bring three coal lumps for its fuel box; existing or traded coal is welcome. If you mine it yourself, use a pickaxe, even wood or stone, on a natural coal source rather than dismantling protected village scenery.

quests.title: The Road to Dur Brannoc
quests.text: Dur Brannoc's gates lead to trainers, repair services and the city's public workspaces. At level 10, follow the road to Dorrin Gateledger in the ancestor hall. Outside the city the country is more dangerous; keep to the route and avoid the higher-level wildlife. Speak with Dorrin and complete this introduction there.
